summary.en: A video of a man who lives a prehistoric lifestyle has gone viral on the Internet. It was filmed by Eita Nakamura while having Tsutomu Iwata as the main reporter, at a waterfall situated near the Mount Hiehata trail in Stone Age village, Hiehata city. Kogoro arrives at the village with Conan and Ran without a disclosed purpose, though they are still looking for the prehistoric man like most others. They find the man when they are hiking on the mountain trail, but unable to catch up with him while finding someone else dead nearby.

locations: Near the stairs that lead to an abandoned temple in Mount Hiehata

victims.name: Saneo Kurauchi
victims.causeOfDeath: Blunt force trauma on his head

suspects: Stone Age Man, Tsutomu Iwata, Fukusuke Tsuzuki, Kotaro Nagakura, and Eita Nakamura
